use_when: 密钥管理
密钥生成
密钥导入导出
密钥协商
密钥认证
访问控制
如何生成AES、RSA、ECC等不同算法类型的密钥？
如何使用明文导入、安全导入或数字信封方式导入外部密钥？
如何使用AES或RSA进行数据的加密和解密操作？
如何使用密钥对数据进行签名和验签？
如何使用ECDH进行密钥协商，或使用HKDF进行密钥派生？
如何配置基于用户身份认证的密钥访问控制？
如何进行密钥证明以验证密钥的合法性？
如何查询密钥是否存在、获取密钥属性、导出和删除密钥？
如何使用HMAC和CMAC进行消息认证码计算？
如何集成外部密钥管理Provider和使用CryptoExtensionAbility？
当你的应用需要对敏感数据进行加密存储或传输时使用本Kit，例如加密用户密码、保护本地文件、实现安全通信等场景
当需要使用数字签名验证数据完整性或身份认证时，应使用签名/验签能力
当应用需要基于用户身份认证（人脸、指纹、口令）来控制密钥访问权限时，HUKS提供了与User Authentication Kit联动的密钥访问控制能力
当需要在应用端和服务器端之间进行安全密钥协商、派生会话密钥时，也应使用本Kit的相关能力
在设备安全区生成并保存应用用到的对称密钥 / Generate and store app encryption keys in the device secure keystore
把用户私钥放进系统密钥库管理而不是明文落盘 / Keep user private keys in the system keystore instead of storing them in plain files
用 Keystore 里的 RSA 或 ECC 密钥给登录请求做签名 / Sign login requests with RSA or ECC keys stored in Keystore
实现只有指纹或锁屏认证通过后才能使用的密钥 / Enforce biometric or device-credential authentication before a key can be used
为本地数据库或文件加密创建不可导出的密钥 / Create non-exportable keys for encrypting local databases or files
接入硬件级密钥保护来保存支付或证书相关密钥 / Integrate hardware-backed key protection for payment or certificate keys
导入服务器下发的证书私钥并交给系统安全存储 / Import server-provided certificate private keys into secure system storage
删除旧密钥并轮换一套新的应用加密密钥 / Rotate application encryption keys by deleting old ones and generating new ones
读取密钥别名和属性来判断当前密钥是否可用 / Read key aliases and properties to verify whether a key is usable
用 ECDH 协商共享密钥后派生会话密钥用于通信加密 / Derive session keys after ECDH key agreement for encrypted communication
给设备生成可证明来源的密钥用于服务端校验设备身份 / Generate attestable keys so the server can verify device identity
把敏感令牌加密后保存，并在需要时用密钥库解密 / Encrypt sensitive tokens for storage and decrypt them with the keystore when needed
preconditions: 工程已集成 Universal Keystore Kit 对应SDK能力，并在目标设备系统版本上受支持 / The project has integrated the Universal Keystore Kit SDK capability and it is supported on the target device OS version
调用方已准备好合法的密钥参数与算法规格，所选算法/用途/长度组合受HUKS支持 / The caller has prepared valid key parameters and algorithm specs, and the chosen algorithm/purpose/size combination is supported by HUKS

若配置了基于用户身份的密钥访问控制，应用已完成相应认证能力接入且用户授权状态满足要求 / If user-identity-based key access control is configured, the app has integrated the required authentication capability and the user's authorization state satisfies the requirement
inputs: 密钥参数集 / key parameter set
待加密、解密、签名或验签的数据 / data to encrypt, decrypt, sign, or verify
导入的密钥材料或对端公钥材料 / imported key material or peer public-key material
访问控制配置 / access control configuration

postconditions.statement: 代码已新增或修改为调用 Universal Keystore Kit（HUKS）相关API来完成密钥管理或密码操作 / The code has been added or updated to call Universal Keystore Kit (HUKS) APIs for key management or cryptographic operations
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly introduce or modify code that uses HarmonyOS Universal Keystore Kit/HUKS APIs for key generation, import/export, encrypt/decrypt, sign/verify, key agreement, derivation, or key queries?

postconditions.statement: 实现中显式提供了与任务匹配的关键参数，如别名、算法、用途、长度或模式等 / The implementation explicitly provides task-appropriate key parameters such as alias, algorithm, purpose, size, or mode
postconditions.judge_prompt: By inspecting the edits, is there explicit configuration or construction of key-related parameters appropriate to the requested HUKS operation (for example alias, algorithm, purpose, key size, digest, padding, block mode, or access control)?

postconditions.statement: 若任务涉及受保护密钥访问，代码体现了认证门槛或访问控制配置，而非无约束使用密钥 / If the task involves protected key access, the code reflects authentication gating or access-control configuration rather than unrestricted key use
postconditions.judge_prompt: If the requested feature mentions user-auth-protected keys or controlled access, do the edits show corresponding access-control or authentication-related HUKS configuration instead of using the key without protection?
